confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated cost-of-living and price-index snippets from 2023 to 2026 sources, which disagree by 50% or more, so the bounded estimates are medium-quality. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct data was weak, and beer is the anchor they derive from. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings, and are lower quality. The FX observation comes from a search summary citing the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA page directly, so verify the 2026-11-18 figure against the official F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Food and drink anchors reflect local-venue prices in Cairo drawn from aggregated price sources, with expat-area and hotel-bar prices treated as upper bounds. Accommodation reflects a general model view of Cairo's registered hostel and hotel market, not a comparable-city lookup.
